parsed.notes: The patch replaces int calculations of a, b, c with long long to avoid overflow for all valid m, n values bounded by sqrt(sumOfSides). The cast back to int for the isPythagorean check is safe because a, b, c will always be within int range for any sum that satisfies a+b+c == sumOfSides. No new vulnerabilities are introduced, and the functional behavior for valid inputs is preserved.
